requirements:
evdev
ycm_core
pyparsing
cryptography
pytest
pefile
Pillow
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-c", "print('systemd Python environment ready')"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with detected imports (PIL mapped to Pillow). Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim, installs dependencies, and includes a minimal startup command. Note: systemd is a C project - these Python dependencies are likely for auxiliary tooling/testing.
